project: Sector Forge 2.5 — Advanced Generation Density and Full Hex-System Editor
implementation: Advanced generation options are collapsed by default; one-click generation continues to use the legacy default settings.
System density presets: Default (legacy 21–30), Empty (0), Scarce (8–14), Normal (31–40), Crowded (45–65).
World & orbital content density independently controls planets, points of interest, and non-star survey installations.
Edit Mode allows creating a system on an empty hex and editing its planets, arbitrary orbital survey objects, and points of interest.
New planets receive stable IDs, a matching survey row, a market, and a world-directory record.
Modal stack hardening prevents a stale or detached modal from inadvertently clearing the live stack.

javascript_syntax_checks.scope: All JavaScript source and test files
